comment: I have to say, McClinton staff were the most welcoming and friendly staff i have ever experienced at an Auto repair shop, and My 4-Runner looks great! I will definitely go back, if need be. Thank you!

The repair job was excellent, thanks for doing a little bit of extra on my daughter‘s car. It comes around to help you out as I send all my friends ,workers and family to you guys. Thanks again for the great work. ,
They did a great job and were very nice . The painter was amazing, hopefully we don't have to go back but if we do we will go there.
Great service, super friendly, I would definitely refer them
Thanks so much for your hard work! My car looks great.
Did a great job, recommend them anytime.
McClinton’s went the extra mile to get my Honda CRV into new condition from the windshield forward. I can’t say enough to recommend this business to anyone needing repair work

I would highly recommend McClinton , it was my first experience with them, and they were so friendly and easy to work with . Josh was great . Hopefully won't need to see them anytime soon, 😄 But if I do , that's where I will go Thank you

We would TOTALLY recommend McClinton Auto Collision. Full disclosure. We took our vehicle there twice on recommendation from our insurance company. We are very happy with our experience there.

The repairs to our Hyundai Tucson makes it like new again.

If I could give McClinton a higher score, I would. Their customer service is excellent!!

They were very thorough and kept me informed of the progress. They completed the repairs a week ahead of schedule.

Great work, staff was easy to work with. Kept me informed every step of the way.

Very helpful.

The Crew did a wonderful job fixing my rear bumper after getting rear ended. I got the car back 3 days earlier than expected. Everything looks brand new! They all rock 🤘🏼

I would send a friend there

We are very happy with the outcome of the work done on my 2025 Chevy equinox! We even got the car back a couple day before the initial expected date it would be finished! Good job everyone!

Everything was great, wonderful customer service
Absolutely 10/10 experience. Very straightforward, professional and easy process.
You guys did an amazing job! The finish on my hood feels like polished glass. You guys are definitely the shop I will be recommending to my friends and family!
